scenarios.name: Close the Constrain expansion when finishing sketch edit

scenario_steps.name: the full Sketch ribbon is visible outside sketch edit
the user enters sketch edit from the model browser
sketch commands become available and the Exit group shows Finish
the user opens the Constrain additional-command area
Edit Coordinate System and Constraint Inference Scope are visible
the user selects Finish without changing sketch geometry
sketch edit ends and the part view returns
the original part geometry remains visible
